conditions.note: Copied from the RDAT ANNOTATION line; cross-checked against the file at run time.

mask_reason: Trailing run of 8 exact zeros at the 3' end (no data at the read end).

report_notes.construct: Hox A5 mRNA 5' UTR (237 nt); the DMS, PAGE-purified row (row 4 of 4: rows 1/3 are 1M7, row 2 DMS non-PAGE).
report_notes.region: R = 1-50: the 5' end of the UTR. The region of interest is the 5'-most stretch with data (uniform rule across datasets: first 50 nt, 100 nt for the 1266-nt HOXA9 UTR), with 5'-anchored windows mimicking the mRNA use case.
data_caveats: RNA was heat-denatured, then folded at 37 °C for 20 min with 10 mM MgCl2; annotated probing temperature 24 °C.
DMS data are normalised so that G/U are 0; G/U are outside E anyway.
